animations.name: Medium Kick Low

Perform ONE SINGLE aggressive Ken-style SF6 crouching medium kick across the clip (one kick only, never twice), pure body motion in empty air: NEVER rise or stand up—keep hips and head strictly low at crouch height throughout the entire wind-up, kick, and recovery. Preserve exact face, hairstyle, varsity jacket, jeans, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Keep entire body inside 512x512 with margin. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
